CREATIVE ARTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. How long does one quaver last? (1 mark)
   A. A quarter of a beat only
   B. Half a beat
   C. One beat
   D. Two beats

2. Which foot is usually placed in front at the start? (1 mark)
   A. The weaker foot always
   B. Neither
   C. The stronger foot, used to kick a ball
   D. Both together

3. The message of a song is (1 mark)
   A. the number of singers
   B. the main idea the singers want us to hear
   C. the name of the drum
   D. the colour of the stage

4. What is charcoal? (1 mark)
   A. A kind of wet paint
   B. Black carbon left when wood is heated with little air
   C. Ground chalk
   D. A type of clay

5. Which of these is a light tone of purple? (1 mark)
   A. Purple mixed with white
   B. Purple mixed with brown
   C. Pure purple
   D. Purple mixed with black

6. Which of these can also take digital photographs? (1 mark)
   A. Xylophone
   B. Broom
   C. Drum
   D. Tablet

7. Before sharing a photograph of others, you should (1 mark)
   A. edit their face
   B. ask them and an adult
   C. hide it
   D. post it at once

8. A rhythmic pattern feels finished when it ends on (1 mark)
   A. a mistake
   B. a rest
   C. a long note
   D. a very short note

9. Why should clay models dry slowly in the shade? (1 mark)
   A. Sun makes them soft
   B. Shade makes them shine
   C. Shade makes them heavy
   D. Fast drying in strong sun can crack them

10. Which two positions are defenders that may enter the goal circle they defend? (1 mark)
   A. WA and C
   B. WD and WA
   C. GS and C
   D. GD and GK

11. Pitch means (1 mark)
   A. the speed of a song
   B. how loud a sound is
   C. how high or low a sound is
   D. how long a sound lasts

12. Which is a safe way to enter the pool? (1 mark)
   A. Head first from a run
   B. Being pushed
   C. Jumping onto others
   D. Feet first, watched by the teacher

13. Which is the beater of a drum? (1 mark)
   A. The rope
   B. The stick or hand that strikes it
   C. The skin
   D. The shell

14. In an overhead pass, the ball starts (1 mark)
   A. behind the knees
   B. between the knees
   C. at the ankles
   D. above the head

15. The mood of a song is (1 mark)
   A. the name of the composer
   B. its length in metres
   C. the feeling it gives
   D. its price

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Name the three secondary colours and state how each is made. (3 marks)

17. Describe the roles in a folk song performance. (4 marks)

18. Name three types of Kenyan folk songs and say when each is sung. (3 marks)

19. Why is it important not to share a recorder before cleaning it? (3 marks)

20. Why should you collect only dead or fallen twigs for charcoal? (2 marks)
pages.answers:
CREATIVE ARTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — Half a beat
   A quaver is half a beat.

2. C — The stronger foot, used to kick a ball
   The stronger foot is the front foot.

3. B — the main idea the singers want us to hear
   Message is the main idea.

4. B — Black carbon left when wood is heated with little air
   Charcoal is the black carbon left after wood is burned with very little air.

5. A — Purple mixed with white
   White makes a tint.

6. D — Tablet
   Many tablets have cameras.

7. B — ask them and an adult
   Respect and safety come first.

8. C — a long note
   Ending on a crotchet, a long note, makes it sound complete.

9. D — Fast drying in strong sun can crack them
   Slow drying prevents cracks.

10. D — GD and GK
   The Goal Defence and the Goal Keeper may play in their defending circle.

11. C — how high or low a sound is
   Pitch is the highness or lowness of a note.

12. D — Feet first, watched by the teacher
   Feet-first entry is safe.

13. B — The stick or hand that strikes it
   The beater is what hits the drumhead.

14. D — above the head
   The ball is lifted above the head before it is thrown.

15. C — the feeling it gives
   Mood is the feeling of a song, such as joy or calm.

SECTION B
----
16. (3 marks)
   Answer: Orange from red and yellow, green from yellow and blue, purple from blue and red.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each secondary colour with its mixture.

17. (4 marks)
   Answer: The soloist leads the song; the chorus answers or repeats; the instrumentalists play instruments to keep the beat; dancers move to the music.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each role.

18. (3 marks)
   Answer: Work songs during work, funeral songs when someone dies, naming songs when a baby is named, initiation songs at initiation, marriage songs at weddings, worship songs at worship. Any three.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each type with its occasion.

19. (3 marks)
   Answer: Germs from the mouth can spread illnesses such as colds through the mouthpiece.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for germs, 1 mark for the mouth or mouthpiece, 1 mark for spreading illness.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: To protect the environment and living trees. Dead twigs are also dry.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for protecting living trees, 1 mark for the environment or dry wood.
